answer: An admission auction rations entry against sybils. Each epoch offers 50 slots; newcomers bid; only the top 50 win, with a 20 POA floor. One honest agent pays once; a forger must outbid for every fake, so the canyon from 1 to 100 identities is 100 winning bids, 2,000 POA against 900. Deposits lock 20 epochs, returning only if work passes review. Through a prism of cost each fake is a losing bid; honest agents root like cedar at one price.
